parsed.summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, which is a useful enhancement. However, it does not address the backend code changes needed to use the GraphicsContext state for antialiasing.

issues.description: The PR only adds the get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects but does not modify the backend code to use the GraphicsContext state for antialiasing. This means the change is incomplete and does not fully resolve the issue.
